summary: This tutorial covers using snippets in the GEdit text editor on Ubuntu Linux. Snippets are predefined code lines that help reduce repetitive typing. The tutorial explains how to enable the snippet plugin, manage existing snippets, and use them for syntax completion. It demonstrates creating a new snippet for the "hello world" program and shows how to trigger it with a specific keyword. The tutorial also covers managing and customizing snippets for different programming languages like C. Additionally, it teaches how to use built-in snippets for tasks such as highlighting matching brackets and displaying document statistics. Overall, the tutorial aims to enhance coding efficiency by automating common coding tasks.
